name: Water Bearer Coffee
tagline: Coffee roasted in house. Syrups made from scratch. A café for the neighborhood.
description: An independent café in Traverse City, Michigan — espresso roasted in house, syrups made from scratch, plus tea, smoothies, breakfast burritos, and sandwiches. Rooted in community and local business.
parkingNote: Street parking along Hall Street and through the Warehouse District, plus nearby public lots. The mobile espresso cart is often out on weekends — check Instagram for where we're parked.
